label: L-02
title: The internally-computed minPhUSDOut is TAUTOLOGICAL and cannot bind: totalPhUSD == minPhUSDOut identically, zero margin
description: _annihilateMeasured passes annihilatable + calculateMintAmount(token, netUsed); Antimatter checks totalPhUSD = amount + mintedForStable against it, and mintedForStable IS exactly calculateMintAmount with no fee and no partial fill (PhusdStableMinter.sol:212,232). Neither hazard the NatSpec names is catchable: rate movement between quote and burn cannot occur because the quote is evaluated in the ARGUMENT EXPRESSION of the guarded call, so there is no window; and a mint cap biting REVERTS rather than under-delivering, so a floor never sees it.
impact: A guard that reads as protection but is provably inert. QA/Low.
severityBasis: C4 Low: spec deviation / dead guard, no value at risk.
recommendation: Either give the floor real margin from an independent quote source, or delete it and correct the NatSpec that claims it protects against rate movement and a mint cap.
knownIssueRuling: NOT SUPPRESSED, and note the DIRECTION: N32 is the item that ASSERTS this floor is 'the only in-path guard against the exchange rate moving or a mint cap biting between quote and burn'. A known issue cannot suppress the finding that refutes its own stated rationale.
